author: designer
label: sprint_t2
prompt:
ACTION: the man from image 1 wins a bunch sprint on a finishing straight, beating a rider in a plain yellow jersey and a rider in a plain white jersey with rainbow chest stripes by half a wheel, then sits up and raises both arms.

THE WINNER: the man from image 1, his face, his metallic dark-blue helmet, violet mirrored sunglasses, plain matte black jersey with white geometric blocks on the left sleeve, black bib shorts, black socks, black bike with tan-wall tyres. All kit plain and unprinted.

SHOT 1 (0-4 s): low tracking shot ahead of the bunch, 35mm lens. Twenty riders in tight formation; the man from image 1 sits third wheel behind yellow and rainbow, then swings right into open road. Whip pan right into shot 2.

SHOT 2 (4-8 s): side tracking shot at hip height, 50mm lens. The three sprint shoulder to shoulder out of the saddle; the man from image 1 edges ahead. Fast push into the front wheels into shot 3.

SHOT 3 (8-12 s): frontal shot from behind the finish line, 85mm lens, slight slow motion. All three throw their bikes at the white line; the man from image 1 crosses first, sits up, arms wide, shouting with joy.

PLACE: sunny finishing straight in a southern French town, dark asphalt, barriers covered in plain solid blue and white boards, plain blank banners, flag-waving spectators, plane trees.
LIGHT: hard late-afternoon sun from camera-left, long shadows.
SOUND: crowd roar building to the line, whirring freewheels, the crowd erupting at the finish.

lint.msg: 257 words. Long prompts bury the action; keep it under ~150 and lead with what happens.
